title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling quickstarts, and docs site updates
author: Jordan Kim
description: Summary: Adds a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates, multiple tool-calling quickstarts (Python + Typescript + Go), and updates the docs site nav and quickstart pages. Motivation: provide self-serve examples for customers adopting agents and tool-calling with Redwood, reduce support load for common integration patterns, and showcase best-practice RAG patterns (chunking, embedding selection, secure tool invocation). This PR includes: - A new `examples/agents/rag-templates/` folder with 3 opinionated templates (faq-bot, summarizer, actions-agent). - Quickstarts demonstrating tool-calling patterns in `redwood-examples/quickstarts/` for Python, Typescript, and Go. Each quickstart includes a runnable README, environment config, and test prompts. - Docs site updates: nav entry, a new quickstart landing page, and architecture notes on safe tool-calling. - Minor README and examples cleanup requested during docs review. Checklist: - [x] RAG templates implemented and tested locally against example dataset - [x] Quickstarts include runnable instructions and CI smoke tests - [x] Docs site navigation and redirects added - [x] Security review for tool-calling patterns completed (scoped invocation, least privilege examples) - [x] Perf notes added for the templates (batching and caching tips) Links: Linear ENG-4123, demo recording: https://internal.redwood.ai/recordings/rag-templates-demo. Testing: unit smoke tests for quickstarts, end-to-end walkthrough validated with local vector store (Chroma in docker). Notes: kept examples intentionally small and opinionated; customers can fork the templates for more advanced setups.
